description: Open a YES/NO market. The wallet seeds it with USDC liquidity (minimum 100) and names a solver — a different address that alone resolves it and stakes 1% as a bond. Trading runs until closeTime; the solver proposes after resolveAfter.

liquidityUsdc.description: USDC liquidity to seed (minimum 100), as a decimal string, e.g. "25" or "0.5"

question.description: a clear YES/NO question with its resolution source and time, e.g. "Will BTC close above $100,000 on Coinbase on Dec 31, 2026 (UTC)?"

resolveAfter.description: ISO 8601 earliest time the solver may propose the outcome (≥ closeTime)

solver.description: the address that will resolve the market (not the wallet)

wallet.description: the agent's wallet address — the one that will sign and send the calls

name: build_create_prediction_market
title: Build: create a prediction market
